_comment: Causal RAG versions. Both run the same Hypothesis Agent, Causal RAG retrieval over the year-filtered CauseTrace graph, Testing Agent (plan, balanced BM25 retrieval, native causal-rag-mvp assessor with verbatim-quote validation, mediator tests, written rubric), status encoder, calibration and allocation, with the same model, limits and seeds. Only the Testing Agent's evidence pool differs (native_backtest/ap3/evidence_pool.py).

reduced_evidence.label: Causal RAG — Reduced Evidence
reduced_evidence.description: Research claims from the year-filtered knowledge graph plus point-in-time numerical data notes (mediator moves, macro surprises). No historical text documents.
reduced_evidence.role: Built because the full-evidence corpus is not yet complete. Not a silent substitute for the originally specified full-evidence system.

historical_documents.label: Causal RAG — With Historical Documents
historical_documents.description: The reduced-evidence pool plus official Federal Reserve, BLS and Census documents published before each decision (the originally specified evidence corpus).
historical_documents.role: The originally specified full-evidence system. Runs once the official-document corpus is complete and validated.

reduced_evidence_policy_proxy.label: Causal RAG — Reduced Evidence, policy-path proxy (sensitivity variant)
reduced_evidence_policy_proxy.description: The reduced-evidence version with FF_FUTURES_6M replaced by a labelled proxy: 2-year Treasury yield minus the 4-week bill rate (pinned data).
reduced_evidence_policy_proxy.role: Separately documented sensitivity variant for the unavailable fed funds futures input. Not part of the frozen specification; never the primary version unless explicitly approved.

secondary_comparison: Historical documents minus reduced evidence on development months: does adding historical textual evidence improve Causal RAG? Development data only; reported as a within-approach experiment.

primary_version.rule: Before the protected 2023-2026 window is opened, the project lead records which version represents Agentic Causal RAG in the three primary contrasts (native_backtest/config/approvals/ap3_primary_version.json). The choice uses development results and readiness only; protected results are never used to select or tune a version. The GO record must name the selected version.
